（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

C. I. S
I. O. REQ
No 521
Date 21/8/16

Shanghai Municipal Council

19th August 1916

Sir,

The Tutuh of Fukien has requested the Director
of the Arsenal to supply him with 30 machine guns,
and the latter has consented to do so.

Some of the leaders of the Manchu Restoration
party, who have been in Shanghai and Woosung for
the past ten days, left for Nanking at 11 p.m.
18th instant.

The City gentry intend to give General Yang
a big gift on his birthday, which falls on 24th
instant.

Your obedient servant,

mwmumustong
Chief Detective Inspector.

kro
19/8.
Captain Superintendent of Police .
pages.zh:
编号
（印章：上海工部局警务处）

警务处，
（侦探股）

C. I. S
I. O. REQ
第 521 号
日期 16/8/21

上海工部局

1916年8月19日

先生：

福建督军已要求兵工厂总监向其供应30挺机枪，后者已同意照办。

满洲复辟派的一些头目过去十天一直身处上海和吴淞，已于本月18日晚11时启程前往南京。

本市绅界打算在本月24日杨将军生日之际，向其赠送一份厚礼。

您顺从的仆人，

mwmumustong
总探长。

kro
8月19日。
警务处巡官队长。
